title: diffusers-invocation-state
summary: Trace Diffusers pipeline-wrapper and scheduler invocation state when repeated calls, from_pipe reuse or interruption produce unexpected schedules or retained request state; scoped to FluxPipeline and FlowMatchEulerDiscreteScheduler source evidence.

skill_metadata.name: diffusers-invocation-state
skill_metadata.description: Trace Diffusers pipeline-wrapper and scheduler invocation state when repeated calls, from_pipe reuse or interruption produce unexpected schedules or retained request state; scoped to FluxPipeline and FlowMatchEulerDiscreteScheduler source evidence.

applicability.scope: FluxPipeline and FlowMatchEulerDiscreteScheduler invocation ownership at this source pin; inspect the actual caller contract.
applicability.prerequisites: Access to the pinned ownership path and an identified caller admission/serialization contract; other pipeline or scheduler classes need their own contracts.
applicability.input_contract: Diffusers/PyTorch revisions, pipeline/scheduler classes and object identities, construction/from_pipe path, actual components, scheduler config and resolved timesteps/sigmas, shape/dtype, callback/interrupt timing, output/cleanup path and overlapping intervals.
applicability.produced_artifact: An object-identity/ownership map and call-to-schedule-reset/step/interrupt/output/cleanup trace, the caller admission contract, one next check and actual evidence status.
applicability.failure_modes: Assuming from_pipe deep-copies scheduler state, passing an enumeration index instead of a scheduler timestep, or treating cooperative iteration skipping as kernel cancellation/exception cleanup can misidentify invocation ownership.
applicability.refusal_point: Stop when the ownership question is resolved or a required fixture/backend is absent; do not infer service-wide race or serialization behavior from this readset.

limitations: Source-derived candidate; no installed API, native scheduler, model, concurrency or service validation.
Supplied manifest verifies a selected pipeline_utils Git blob, not the whole source tree.
Other pipelines and schedulers require separate contracts; common indexing is not backend qualification.
recommendations: Check wrapper and scheduler identities explicitly and follow the effective schedule reset and step-index progression.
Trace interruption through its loop-boundary consumer and normal decode/cleanup tail while preserving the caller's existing shared-state serialization.
Use a real scheduler CPU check only for its scheduler cycle; keep pipeline reuse/interruption and serving claims tied to matching fixtures and execution evidence.
